title: Trip to Russia to save KGB files

tellings.quote:
I I went to Russia once trying to save
the KGB files.

plain: The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn, who keeps a large archive of UFO material, says he once travelled to Russia to try to save the KGB's files on the subject. He tells Michels simply, "I went to Russia once trying to save the KGB files." If such files exist, they would hold the Soviet secret police's own records of UFO reports.
